author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring Comic Artists, Writers & More
content: HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE ⤵️ We’re looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects. These positions include: Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, animators, music producers, language translators, comic writers/editors, personal assistants, video/reel editors/promoters, content creators & more. author: puffballstudios
title: Artist Call for Abida Comic Line Art
content: 📢📢 ARTIST CALL FOR ABIDA📢📢 Doston, Puffball Comics is officially on a hunt for an exceptional Line Art Finishing Artist to join the production team for @theabidacomic Issue #2 We're looking for someone who can smoothly step into an established visual world and help us complete pages while maintaining the style, character, and energy of the graphic novel. What you'll be working on: ○ Finishing and refining line art / inks ○ Supporting the completion of illustrated pages ○ Adding shadows, lighting, and finishing touches ○ Working from existing artwork, layouts, and visual references under Lead Artist's direction You should apply if you have strong character drawing and anatomy skills, a solid understanding of perspective, movement, and exaggeration, with clean, confident linework. You should also be comfortable adapting to an existing visual style and maintaining consistency across characters, environments, and sequential panels. If this sounds like you, send us your portfolio at contact@puffball.pk

author: dragon_trappers_lodge
title: Hiring Concept Artist for Fantasy Miniatures
content: WE'RE HIRING: CONCEPT ARTIST! ⚔️ The position will entail creating 2d concept art for 3d printable fantasy miniatures. Concepts will need to be refined line art drawings. No rendering, color, or value work required. Typically no turnarounds required, occasional weapon or prop details may be needed. Often there will be multiple poses which will require loose sketches. 👉We pay $100/concept with more complex detailed creatures granting more pay on a case by case basis. If you enjoy designing characters and monsters but don't like spending weeks on the same design then this is for you. You will be able to work on many designs and someone who works quick will thrive in this role. The quicker you work the more we can send you. Creativity is extremely valuable and there is lots of room for creative freedom. People who don't work quickly, or are unable to take direction and revisions won't do well in this position. The following skill sets are required. ✔️in depth understanding of human anatomy ✔️in depth understanding of creature and animal anatomy ✔️great drawing and sketching skills ✔️understanding of dynamic posing ⚠️ IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ: All applications must be submitted through our official BambooHR hiring page, linked in our bio.
